FN-0IZTCG-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 203
Committee: Boards, Agencies and Sponsor: Representative Chris Pringle
Commissions
Analyst: JT Mathis Date: 03/28/2023
House Bill 203 as introduced provides for the continuance of the Board of Examiners on
Admission to the State Bar until October 1, 2027 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill
will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
